intended_behavior: Extend or add a new step that explicitly queries the LLM to generate a list of QA tasks based on the project specification, then asks the LLM to inspect the generated code and determine if it passes or fails each QA task. If issues are detected, allow the LLM to output code block fixes which overwrite relevant files, thereby implementing self-healing. This replaces or supplements the existing manual human review while preserving existing functionality.

Add methods to support the new QA flow. These methods should enable sending prompts to the LLM to (1) produce a manual test QA checklist from project specs, (2) inspect generated code for QA task pass/fail assessment, and (3) generate self-healing code blocks that can fix detected issues. These methods should integrate with existing backoff_inference to manage robust interaction with the model. This extends AI class functionality without breaking existing usage.
No change required unless integration with or fallback to human feedback is desired. Can preserve current manual user input flow.
